simple.meaning: יְקַד (yᵉqad) is a Hebrew word meaning “burning.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יְקַד (H3345) appears 8 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Daniel 3:6, with occurrences in Daniel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יְקַד (H3345) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in יְקַד (H3345) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: יְקַד (yᵉqad) / H3345 is traced through Daniel 3:6, Daniel 3:11, Daniel 3:15, Daniel 3:17 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Whoever doesn’t fall down and worship shall be cast into the middle of a burning fiery furnace the same hour.”

timeline.evidenceText: Whoever doesn’t fall down and worship shall be cast into the middle of a burning fiery furnace the same hour.”
and whoever doesn’t fall down and worship shall be cast into the middle of a burning fiery furnace.

Now if you are ready whenever you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music to fall down and worship the image which I have made, good; but if you don’t worship, you shall be cast the same hour into the middle of a burning fiery furnace. Who is that god that will deliver you out of my hands?”
If it happens, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace; and he will deliver us out of your hand, O king.
He commanded certain mighty men who were in his army to bind Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, and to cast them into the burning fiery furnace.
Then these men were bound in their pants, their tunics, and their mantles, and their other clothes, and were cast into the middle of the burning fiery furnace.
These three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, fell down bound into the middle of the burning fiery furnace.
Then Nebuchadnezzar came near to the mouth of the burning fiery furnace. He spoke and said, “Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, you servants of the Most High God, come out, and come here!”
